title: Add a pin to a component's library symbol and reload it
summary: Goes from a placed schematic component to its source .SchLib, adds a pin to the symbol, saves the library and swaps the placed component for the updated symbol while keeping its location, designator and part.
phrasings: edit the library symbol of a placed component
add a pin to a SchLib symbol and save the library
update a placed part from its library
open a schematic library from code
find the source library of a schematic component

commands.name: EditSchLibComponent
commands.description: Add a pin to a component's library symbol and reload it
commands.params: Designator=<x> (else the PopupMenuHitTest component, else the one selected component)|Library=<.SchLib path> (optional)|LibraryFolder=<folder> (optional)|PinDesignator=0|PinName=0|PinX=400|PinY=330 (mils)
